Let \(P=H+t(F-H)=(4t,2+2t)\).

Area of \(AEPH\):
\[
[ AEPH]=\frac12\left|3(2+2t)+4t\cdot 2\right|
=\frac12(6+14t)=3+7t.
\]
Given \([AEPH]=5\), so
\[
3+7t=5 \implies t=\frac27.
\]
Thus
\[
P=\left(\frac87,\frac{18}{7}\right).
\]

Now compute \([PFCG]\) using shoelace with \(P(\frac87,\frac{18}{7}), F(4,4), C(4,6), G(1,6)\):
\[
[PFCG]=\frac12\left|\left(\frac87\cdot4+4\cdot6+4\cdot6+1\cdot\frac{18}{7}\right)
-\left(\frac{18}{7}\cdot4+4\cdot4+6\cdot1+6\cdot\frac87\right)\right|.
\]
\[
=\frac12\left|\frac{386}{7}-\frac{274}{7}\right|
=\frac12\cdot 16=8.
\]

\[
\boxed{8}
\]
